statement: Acting around a boundary without notifying overseers, when the agent's judgment can't be checked from outside, isn't justified below manifest irreversible harm, if an escalation channel exists.
scope: current AI agents; environments where AI judgment can't be verified from outside
conditions: an escalation channel exists. If none exists, record the conflict; do not resolve it.
review_condition: when external verification of agent judgment improves
notes: statement unchanged from S1v2. TAG_REVISION 2026-11-05 (grounding_outside_law.md): the stance rests on VERIFIABILITY, not legality; POWER_POSITION added to its legitimacy premise. Entered against this record's own co-author.
